item.subject: science
item.stem:
Meena connects the same nichrome wire first to one cell and then to two cells, each time for exactly 5 minutes, and compares the heat produced. Her brother says the heating of wires is always a bad thing.
Which statement is correct?

options.A: Two cells produce more heat in the same time, but all electrical heating is harmful, including in an electric iron.
options.B: Two cells produce more heat in the same time than one cell, and this heating is useful in appliances like an iron but harmful when a plug overheats.
options.C: One cell produces more heat than two cells in the same wire over the same time, and this heating is useful in an electric iron.
options.D: The same wire produces the same heat with one cell or two cells in 5 minutes, so overheating at a plug cannot happen.
